newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Tractebel looks closer at Powerfin merger.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Tractebel looks closer at Powerfin merger.

text.p: Belgian utility holding company Tractebel SA said on Thursday it had asked three banks to look closer into the benefits of a full merger with its international energy unit Powerfin.
"Tractebel has asked three banks -- Kredietbank, Petercam and S.G. Warburg -- to give an opinion on the conversion terms of a merger," spokesman Francois Desclee told Reuters.
Desclee did not expect a full decision on whether to go ahead with the merger before March, when final 1996 accounts are approved by the relevant boards.

"If we had decided to do the merger now, we would have to base the statements on interim accounts and it's very difficult to do because Tractebel is a big company and the accounts are very complicated," he said.
"We prefer to wait for the accounts for the year, when they will be audited and very precise, before we take a decision," he added.

"The board of directors of Tractebel will consider the possibility of a merger between Tractebel and Powerfin once the two companies' annual accounts have been finalised. This is to ensure the transparency necessary for any major transaction," the company said in a statement issued at the end of a regular board meeting.

Tractebel and its controlling shareholder Societe Generale de Belgique have been looking into the possibility of a full merger with Powerfin since September, when SGB increased its stake in the group to 65 percent.
